source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When this model is destroyed for the first time, roll a D6 once that phase ends. On a 2+, put this model back on the battlefield with all its wounds, as close as it can be to the spot where it was destroyed while staying outside Engagement Range of every enemy unit.

setBackUp.placement: as close as possible to where destroyed, not within Engagement Range of enemy units
